text:
Riley C.: hey team — first day here, excited! :wave: quick access issue: Okta shows Google Workspace and 1Password in my app list, but clicking Drive gives a red banner 'Application not assigned to user' and 1Password gets stuck in a redirect loop with 'SAML assertion mismatch'. Tried incognito and reboot. Who should I ping to get apps fully provisioned?
Leah (IT): welcome Riley! :wave: can you confirm your company email (and paste the exact error text or a screenshot link)? we'll take a look.
Riley C.: it's riley.c@redwood.com. screenshot: https://imgur.com/mock-screenshot (red banner says "Application not assigned to user")
DevOps Bot: Ticket created #INC-2026 by Leah (IT): New user provisioning issue for riley.c@redwood.com
Leah (IT): thanks — looks like SCIM provisioning lagged on the Google Workspace groups during your onboarding push. Tom from infra will manually assign Drive while SCIM catches up.
Tom L.: assigned Google Workspace (Drive + Team Drive) to riley.c@redwood.com. Give it ~2 minutes and try again.
Riley C.: retried — Drive opens now, thanks! 1Password still redirecting on SSO though.
Tom L.: for 1Password try clearing cookies for 1password.com and app.redwood.com or test in an incognito window. Also check if MFA is enrolled; SSO can loop if the account hasn't completed second-factor setup.
Riley C.: MFA shows 'Waiting for approval' but my phone never gets a push. I tried SMS and that didn't come either.
Samira N.: quick question — are you on a company-managed phone or a personal device? Some mobile pushes are blocked by older OS versions.
Riley C.: personal Android 11.
Leah (IT): looks like your phone number wasn't added by SCIM. I'm adding +1-415-555-0142 to your Okta profile now and enabling backup SMS.
Tom L.: re-sent the MFA enrollment push after the number update. If push doesn't show up, you should get an SMS with a one-time code in ~30s. If both fail we can enroll a WebAuthn key (YubiKey) as fallback.
Riley C.: got the SMS code, entered it, and enrolled MFA. 1Password SSO works now — login successful. Huge thanks everyone :raised_hands: :tada:
Leah (IT): awesome — closing the ticket in an hour if there are no regressions. If you need elevated GitHub/Slack perms or access to any internal docs, DM me and I'll route it. :lock:
Riley C.: will do. Really appreciate the quick turnaround and help — excited to be here! :heart:
